annotationRationale: Whole-cent prices force a common-multiple condition. Prime factorizations compute the least common multiple, and integer prices verify attainability.
sourceMethod: Follows the official common-multiple argument for the money amount, including checking the prices when the amount is 420 cents.

review.sourceMethodCheck: Faithful, originally worded adaptation of official solution 7 on page 4, retaining the common-multiple condition, prime-exponent calculation, and integer-price verification.
review.annotationCheck: LCM is appropriately assessed, with prime factorization serving as supporting computation.
